name: Option Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies whether it is a call option (right to purchase a specific underlying asset) or a put option (right to sell a specific underlying asset) or any other type of option.

CALL.name: Call
CALL.definition: Right to buy a quantity of an asset for an agreed price at exercise date.

PUTO.name: Put
PUTO.definition: Right to sell a quantity of an asset for an agreed price at exercise date.

OTHR.name: Other
OTHR.definition: Right where the holder of the option decides whether the option is put or call.
